purpose: Recommended wind, gust and turbulence parameters for a Venus rotorcraft flight simulator at 45-70 km. Every value has a unit, a tag and a source. Change [Y] values freely; keep [D]/[K] values unless you have better data.

tags.D: read at the primary source in this session (5 Nov 2026)
tags.D-ag: secondary source, or read by an earlier agent/session (note named in source)
tags.K: computed in this session from [D] values (method in note)

frames.world: x east, y north, z up; the super-rotation blows toward -x (westward)
frames.advice: Move the vehicle in the air-mass frame: the mean wind only carries it. Add the components below on top of the mean wind.

zonal_profile.value: use columns u_west_ms_mean / _min / _max of venus_atmosphere_40_70km.csv (40-64 km); above 64 km use 95-100 m/s
zonal_profile.source: Pioneer Venus DLBI tables (PDS, E_02); cloud-top value ~100 m/s between about 45S and 45N (Sanchez-Lavega 2017 abstract and Sect. 2.2, E_11)

zonal_at_60km_cloud_tracked.source: Sanchez-Lavega 2017 Sect. 2.2: mean constant velocity between +-45 deg at ~60 km is 70 m/s (E_11)

latitude_law.value: u(lat) = u_eq for |lat| <= 45 deg; poleward, reduce linearly to 0 at the pole
latitude_law.source: Sanchez-Lavega 2017 Sect. 2.2: nearly constant ~100 m/s between +-45 deg, decreasing toward the pole (E_11). Linear decrease is our simplification.

local_time_variation_cloud_top.unit: m/s increase from 07 h to 17 h LT, 10-40 deg latitude, 65-70 km only
local_time_variation_cloud_top.source: Sanchez-Lavega 2017 Sect. 2.4 (E_11). No LT dependence detected at 60 km and 47 km.

meridional_cloud_layer.source: PV probes: in the cloud region (above ~45 km) meridional wind between -5 and +5 m/s (Sanchez-Lavega 2017 Sect. 2.3.1, E_11); PV DLBI in this session gives -7.1 ... +5.8 m/s at 40-60 km (E_02); VEGA balloons V -6.25 ... +4.44 m/s at 53-54 km (E_04)

meridional_cloud_top.unit: m/s poleward, peak near 60 deg latitude, 65-70 km

value.47-56 km: < 1 m/s per km on average, but PV large probe 56->60 km about 6 m/s per km
value.56-62 km: use the csv profile (about 5-10 m/s per km)

vertical_shear.source: csv u_west_ms_mean gradient (E_02); VEX VIRTIS shear in A_winds_cloudtracking_vex_akatsuki.md (earlier session)

applies.source: convective/low-stability layer: Lefevre 2018 model 46-55 km (9 km thick, matches VEX/Akatsuki RO); Ando 2020 low stability 50-58 km at low latitude, down to ~42 km poleward of 75 deg (E_08, E_10)

sigma_w.source: VEGA-1 sd 0.663, VEGA-2 sd 0.731 m/s of anemometer vertical wind W_a, flag>=2 samples, 53-54 km (E_04, script vega_stats.py)

mean_offset_note.source: both VEGA W_a records have a mean of -0.48 ... -0.50 m/s. We read this as instrument/balloon bias, not a 46 h mean downdraft [Y]; use zero mean in the sim.

process.value: first-order Gauss-Markov (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck) in time, drifting with the air

lagrangian_time_scale.source: VEGA W_a autocorrelation: R(300 s)=0.78, R(600 s)=0.59-0.71, R(1200 s)=0.53-0.56, R(1800 s)=0.28 -> 1/e at ~1500 s (E_04). Sampling is 75.5 s, so periods < ~150 s are not resolved by this record.

eulerian_length_scale.source: half the convective cell width: cells ~6 km (noon) to 15 km (midnight) in Lefevre 2017, ~20 km in Lefevre 2018; VEGA: hundreds of metres to tens of km (E_09, E_10)

effective_correlation_time.source: combine Lagrangian decay with frozen-pattern advection at airspeed V_air

cell_geometry_option.value: broad updrafts in cell centres, narrow strong downdrafts at cell edges; cell aspect ratio (width/depth) ~3

amplitude.source: VEGA: downdrafts 2-3.5 m/s (Linkin 1986 via Lefevre 2017/2018 intro; E_09); most negative 1 h mean in this session's data: VEGA-1 -2.23, VEGA-2 -1.71 m/s (E_04)

duration.source: TM-88516 via A_vega1985_balloons_lander.md; consistent with 1 h means above

altitude_excursion.source: VEGA-2 588->884 hPa (A_vega1985 note); 'downdrafts to 3.5 m/s, 2.5 km excursions' (B_vega_balloon)

rate.source: about one large event per 46 h balloon record (VEGA-1 and VEGA-2), rounded up for test value

shape.value: trapezoid: 10 min ramp, plateau, 10 min ramp; add on top of component A

form.value: Dryden, MIL-F-8785C transfer functions: Hu = sigma_u*sqrt(2 Lu/(pi V)) / (1 + (Lu/V) s); Hv = sigma_v*sqrt(Lv/(pi V)) (1 + sqrt(3) (Lv/V) s)/(1 + (Lv/V) s)^2; Hw same as Hv with Lw, sigma_w
form.source: MathWorks Aerospace Blockset 'Dryden Wind Turbulence Model (Continuous)' page, citing MIL-F-8785C (E_13)

sigma_u.source: VEGA horizontal velocity fluctuations at 30-130 s periods: 0.05-1 m/s (VEGA-2), up to 2 m/s (VEGA-1), true value ~1.5x measured; turbulent > 50 % of the time (Kerzhanovich, TM-88516, via A_vega1985 note)

sigma_w.source: small-scale part only; the total vertical variance is dominated by component A

L_u_L_v_L_w.tag: Y (value = MIL-F-8785C medium/high altitude 1750 ft, D-ag)
L_u_L_v_L_w.source: MIL default (E_13); also about 0.1 x the 5-9 km convective layer depth [Y]. A vehicle at 8 m/s then sees ~65 s correlation, inside the measured 30-130 s periods.

low_speed_rule.value: use V = max(V_air, 2 m/s) in the filters
low_speed_rule.source: Dryden filters contain 1/V (E_13); hover needs a floor

outside_convective_layer.unit: scale factor on all sigma above 57 km and below 47 km
outside_convective_layer.source: stable layers (static stability 1-4 K/km below 50 km, > 4 K/km above 58 km; Ando 2020, E_08)

temperature_amplitude.source: Lefevre 2018: -0.7 ... +0.5 K at 57 km, about 2x weaker than VeRa (> 1 K) (E_10)

horizontal_wavelength.source: 1-6 km at 57 km without shear, up to 20 km with superrotation shear (Lefevre 2018, E_10)

vertical_wind_effect.value: small for flight (tenths of m/s); use for visuals (cloud banding) and as density perturbation

probe_to_probe_density_spread_55km.source: 4 PV probes + VEGA-2 lander (csv rho_kgm3_min/max, E_01, E_04)

latitude_density_spread_65km.source: Venus-GRAM 10N-80N low/high (csv rho_gram_lat_lo/hi, E_07). Above 60 km latitude matters more than time of day.

local_time_temperature_at_55km.value: very low variability with local time in VeRa profiles

minimum_T_uncertainty_band.unit: K at 50-60 km, low latitude; 10-15 K poleward of ~50 deg above 60 km

severe_convective.tag: Y (upper end of VEGA extremes; LES without large-scale heating gave -4.7 ... +2.8 m/s, Lefevre 2017 Sect. 4.2, E_09)
